name: sched_rr_get_interval
description: Retrieves the SCHED_RR time quantum for a specified process and stores it in a timespec structure. The process must be running under the SCHED_RR scheduling policy. If pid is zero, it retrieves the quantum for the calling process.

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: The process ID; if zero, refers to the calling process.

parameters.name: tp
parameters.description: Pointer to a timespec structure where the round-robin time quantum is stored.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: Problem with copying information to user space.
The system call is not yet implemented (only on rather old kernels).
Could not find a process with the ID pid.
